en: A sepia-toned postcard view of a large public square with an imposing central monument consisting of a standing figure and several reclining figures around a massive pedestal. Historic multi‑story baroque and eclectic buildings surround the square. People in mid‑20th‑century clothing walk and stand near the monument. Printed captions in a Slavic language are located below the image.
